items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey ruled out with concussion (mid-game evaluation).
items.implication: Ends day early; monitor for Week 7 clearance. Targets to other Chargers WRs.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston / remaining LAC receivers snap/target boost rest of game and potentially next.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore inactive; Josh Palmer active.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; Bills WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Josh Palmer and other Bills pass-catchers elevated.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Week 6 after GTD/ankle. Browns limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS signee).
items.why: Ankle; failed pregame workout after limited practice.
items.implication: Zero fantasy value; Browns RB committee thin and low-upside.
items.opportunity: Primary carries to McLaughlin/Estime in run-light offense.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active for Titans.
items.implication: Colts TE1 out; stream or pivot needed at TE.
items.opportunity: Increased TE targets elsewhere or Colts pass-catchers; Spears handcuff/backup role expands.

items.text: Eagles place Jalen Hurts on IR (blood clot in calf); out indefinitely. Tanner McKee starts. Jaydon Blue activated.
items.implication: Multi-week absence minimum; McKee low-upside passer, no rush.
items.opportunity: Pass-catchers (Smith active) see volume but lower efficiency; Blue/Pierce backfield if Barkley also out.

items.text: Post-Sunday injuries watching: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned), Doubs/Bateman (shoulder), Mooney (neck).
items.implication: Week 7 availability TBD; Adams/McConkey high priority.
items.opportunity: If out next week, handcuffs/backups and teammate target spikes.

items.text: Updated ranks: Cam Skattebo RB28 (still start for explosiveness vs NO but riskier flex than prior RB2). Najee Harris RB33. Prefers Skattebo if forced to start NYG RB.
items.why: Post-rotation news and fumbles; still likes big-play upside.
items.implication: Demote from safe starter to boom/bust flex.
items.conflict: Analyst still starts over pure volume play despite usage downgrade risk.

items.text: Cam Skattebo 37th/43 in rush YOE with 4 fumbles; Giants expected to expand Najee Harris role while keeping Skattebo in mix. All 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles prompting rotation change per sources.
items.implication: Riskier flex; volume split likely reduces ceiling.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris larger share of carries/snaps.

items.text: Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara expected to play/active. Confirmed in actives.
items.implication: Full or near-full workloads expected; start with confidence.

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson expected to play (Brown activated/full practice).
items.implication: Brown full workload WR1; Henderson mixed but limited red-zone lately.
items.opportunity: Brown targets high; Stevenson still primary if Henderson limited.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf; Not Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Blue.
items.implication: Core pregame monitoring list; many resolved to active/out.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for outs as noted separately.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
items.implication: Sit; Commanders WR targets to others (McLaurin/Samuel alternatives).

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI elite usage), Javonte Williams (RB8 goal-line), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9). Also run-heavy scripts for Kenneth Walker and Jaylen Warren.
items.why: Volume + soft run defenses; Kyren usage elite, Javonte GL work.
items.implication: Prioritize in lineups; strong start candidates.
items.opportunity: High carry/target shares in favorable scripts.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH). Hates Jaylen Waddle, Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass-catchers; usage bankable for London. Hates on matchup/QB issues.
items.opportunity: High target shares vs soft secondary.
